title: Formal Restricted Proof Consolidation Review
purpose: Review FRPR-001 through FRPR-009 and determine whether MT-001/002/003 are ready for external-style formal review preparation under restricted assumptions.
review_findings: Proof skeletons for MT-001, MT-002, and MT-003 correctly trace to FSUB substrate objects.
Formal local proof attempts for MT-001/002/003 show derivability under restricted neighborhood assumptions.
Counterexample persistence audit confirms that failure boundaries (e.g., orientation locking) remain visible.
Assumption minimality review confirms no hidden globality or silent identity collapse in the proof steps.
Restricted derivability classification successfully assigns non-inflationary status to each proof attempt.
Stress tests verify that the formal review layer blocks unauthorized theorem promotion and counterexample suppression.
Proofs remain strictly conditional and bounded to the local restricted domain.
remaining_risks: Locally derivable status is not a global proof; any extension requires new substrate-level preconditions.
Counterexamples represent active structural boundaries that limit the applicability of the local theorems.
Peer-review readiness depends on the thoroughness of the granted FSUB assumptions.
forbidden_next_steps: Claiming physical derivation from local proofs.
Claiming global closure from restricted derivability.
Claiming ontology proof from theorem support.
